s0101.literal: Bayan entered Lin'an and dispatched langzhong Meng Qi to register the ritual instruments, registers and seals, and suburban sacrifice regalia of the Song ancestral temple's Four Ancestors Hall and Jingling Palace, and the books, sacrificial vessels, musical instruments, and other objects of the Secretariat, Directorate of Education, Institute of National History, Hanlin Academy, and Court of Imperial Sacrifices.
s0101.idiomatic: Bayan entered Lin'an and sent langzhong Meng Qi to inventory ritual gear, registers, seals, and suburban regalia from the Song ancestral temple and Jingling Palace, together with books, sacrificial vessels, instruments, and other holdings of the secretariat, directorate of education, national history institute, Hanlin academy, and court of imperial sacrifices.

s0102.literal: On wuchen day weapons were collected from pacified Jiangnan prefectures and districts.
s0102.idiomatic: On wuchen day weapons were collected from pacified Jiangnan prefectures and districts.

s0103.literal: On jiaxu day Aju sent messengers reporting that Xia Gui of Luzhou had surrendered; Wen Tianxiang fled from Zhenjiang but pursuit failed to capture him.
s0103.idiomatic: On jiaxu day Aju reported that Xia Gui of Luzhou had surrendered; Wen Tianxiang fled Zhenjiang but could not be caught.

s0104.literal: The branch secretariat of Jinghunan Route reported: "Now that Tanzhou is settled and Hunan prefectures are surrendering in succession, generals should be dispatched at once to garrison the region.
s0104.idiomatic: The Jinghunan branch secretariat reported that with Tanzhou settled and Hunan prefectures submitting one after another, generals should be sent at once to garrison the region.

s0106.literal: Song Prince of Fu Zhao Yourui came from eastern Zhe to Bayan's camp.
s0106.idiomatic: Song Prince of Fu Zhao Yourui came from eastern Zhe to Bayan's camp.

s0107.literal: Because Dusong Pass garrison commander Zhang Ru had once killed envoy Lian Xixian, he was beheaded and his property confiscated.
s0107.idiomatic: Because Dusong Pass commander Zhang Ru had killed envoy Lian Xixian, he was beheaded and his property was confiscated.

s0108.literal: On yihai day Bayan and others departed Lin'an.
s0108.idiomatic: On yihai day Bayan and his party left Lin'an.

s0109.literal: On dingchou day Atahai, Alaghan, and Dong Wenbing went to the Song sovereign's palace and urged Zhao Shi and the empress dowager to come to audience.
s0109.idiomatic: On dingchou day Atahai, Alaghan, and Dong Wenbing went to the Song palace and pressed Zhao Shi and the empress dowager to come to audience.

s0110.literal: Langzhong Meng Qi read the edict aloud; when he reached the phrase "spared the halter and the leading sheep," Empress Dowager Quan wept and said to Zhao Shi: "You owe your life to the Son of Heaven's mercy; you should bow toward the palace in thanks.
s0110.idiomatic: Langzhong Meng Qi read the edict aloud; at the words "spared the halter and the leading sheep," Empress Dowager Quan wept and told Zhao Shi, "The Son of Heaven's mercy has spared your life; you should bow toward the palace in thanks.

s0111.literal: " After Zhao Shi finished bowing, mother and son both left the palace in sedan chairs; only Grand Empress Dowager Xie remained behind on account of illness.
s0111.idiomatic: " After Zhao Shi bowed, mother and son left the palace in sedan chairs; only Grand Empress Dowager Xie stayed behind, ill.

s0112.literal: On wuyin day an edict exempted three thousand eight hundred ninety Confucian households versed in literature across all routes from corvée; wealthy persons who had used Confucian status to evade service were made commoners; five hundred impoverished households were placed under the Court of Imperial Sacrifices.
s0112.idiomatic: On wuyin day an edict exempted 3,890 literate Confucian households on all routes from corvée, reclassified wealthy men who had used Confucian status to dodge service as commoners, and placed 500 poor households under the court of imperial sacrifices.

s0113.literal: An edict established a chief wanhu headquarters at Luzhou in Huai-xi, with right vice chancellor and Henan-route pacification commissioner Qara Qasun and Xiangyang garrison wanhu Di Jie jointly administering affairs.
s0113.idiomatic: An edict established a chief wanhu headquarters at Luzhou in Huai-xi, with right vice chancellor and Henan-route pacification commissioner Qara Qasun and Xiangyang garrison wanhu Di Jie jointly running it.

s0114.literal: On gengchen day Nangadai presented the Song imperial seal.
s0114.idiomatic: On gengchen day Nangadai presented the Song imperial seal.

s0115.literal: On yiyou day the four prefectures Gan, Ji, Yuan, and Nan'an submitted.
s0115.idiomatic: On yiyou day the four prefectures Gan, Ji, Yuan, and Nan'an submitted.

s0116.literal: On gengyin day Prince of Commandery Gudai was granted a silver seal.
s0116.idiomatic: On gengyin day Prince Gudai was granted a silver seal.

s0117.literal: An edict directed that requisitioned labor and government purchases at Shangdu follow the capital precedent.
s0117.idiomatic: An edict directed that requisitioned labor and government purchases at Shangdu follow the Dadu precedent.

s0118.literal: Right vice chancellor Siben was made minister of revenue.
s0118.idiomatic: Right vice chancellor Siben was made minister of revenue.

s0119.literal: In the intercalary month, on bingshen day, a pacification commission was established at Jining Route to print paper currency and supply Jiangnan military stores.
s0119.idiomatic: In the intercalary month, on bingshen day, a pacification commission was set up at Jining Route to print paper currency and supply Jiangnan military stores.

s0120.literal: Former Xixia Zhongxing acting branch secretariat officer Endure'isi and Dadu Route chief administrator Zhang Shouzhi were both made pacification commissioners.
s0120.idiomatic: Former Xixia Zhongxing acting branch secretariat officer Endure'isi and Dadu Route chief administrator Zhang Shouzhi were both made pacification commissioners.

s0121.literal: Eastern Sichuan mobile privy council commander-in-chief Wang Weizheng reduced territory in Fu Prefecture and took twenty-three stockade, stream, and cave strongholds.
s0121.idiomatic: Eastern Sichuan mobile privy council commander Wang Weizheng reduced Fu Prefecture and took twenty-three stockade, stream, and cave strongholds.

s0122.literal: On dingyou day an edict summoned Hu-Guang Ala Haiya and Qutuq Temür to court and left Toq Buqa and Cui Bin behind at E Prefecture.
s0122.idiomatic: On dingyou day an edict summoned Hu-Guang Ala Haiya and Qutuq Temür to court and left Toq Buqa and Cui Bin in charge at E Prefecture.

s0123.literal: On xinhai day Vice Privy Councillor Zhang Yi was ordered to send surrendered Song ministers Wu Jian, Xia Gui, and others to Shangdu.
s0123.idiomatic: On xinhai day Vice Privy Councillor Zhang Yi was ordered to send surrendered Song ministers Wu Jian, Xia Gui, and others to Shangdu.

s0124.literal: On wuwu day the Huai-xi wanhu headquarters won over six stockades including Fangshan.
s0124.idiomatic: On wuwu day the Huai-xi wanhu headquarters won over six stockades including Fangshan.

s0125.literal: On jiazi day Western Tibetan monks were forbidden to carry weapons.
s0125.idiomatic: On jiazi day Western Tibetan monks were forbidden to carry weapons.

s0126.literal: Central Secretariat left and right bureau langzhong Hao Zhen was made vice grand councillor.
s0126.idiomatic: Central Secretariat left and right bureau langzhong Hao Zhen was made vice grand councillor.

s0127.literal: In summer, fourth month, on the yichou new moon, because Song Gaoyou and Baoying had once supplied Yangzhou, Aju left Mongol commander Tanchie and Shi Bi to guard them and separately dispatched grand marshal Borughan and others to attack Xincheng in Taizhou Prefecture.
s0127.idiomatic: In summer, on the yichou new moon of the fourth month, because Song Gaoyou and Baoying had once supplied Yangzhou, Aju left Mongol commander Tanchie and Shi Bi to hold them and sent grand marshal Borughan and others against Xincheng in Taizhou Prefecture.

s0128.literal: On dingmao day Prince Doru was granted a gold seal.
s0128.idiomatic: On dingmao day Prince Doru was granted a gold seal.

s0129.literal: On wuchen day, because Henan hostilities had not ceased and Kaiyuan Route suffered famine, the prohibition on slaughter in the first and fifth months was relaxed.
s0129.idiomatic: On wuchen day, because fighting in Henan continued and Kaiyuan Route was in famine, the ban on slaughter in the first and fifth months was lifted.

s0130.literal: On gengwu day an edict forbade hindering southern merchants trading in the capital.
s0130.idiomatic: On gengwu day an edict forbade hindering southern merchants trading in the capital.

s0131.literal: On xinwei day Jiangxi mobile commander Song Dudu presented six men including examination-appointed Confucian, physician, and diviner Zheng Mengde; an edict placed them under the Directorate of Archives.
s0131.idiomatic: On xinwei day Jiangxi mobile commander Song Dudu presented six men including examination appointee Zheng Mengde, a Confucian, physician, and diviner; an edict placed them under the directorate of archives.

s0132.literal: On bingzi day the Eastern Sichuan mobile privy council and Chengdu pacification commission were abolished and their affairs merged into the Western Sichuan mobile privy council.
s0132.idiomatic: On bingzi day the Eastern Sichuan mobile privy council and Chengdu pacification commission were abolished and their affairs merged into the Western Sichuan mobile privy council.

s0133.literal: Residents of Shiren Mountain stockade were resettled in Xinyang Army.
s0133.idiomatic: Residents of Shiren Mountain stockade were resettled in Xinyang Army.

s0134.literal: Medical households of the capital were exempted from silk and silver levies for Zhiyuan year twelve.
s0134.idiomatic: Capital medical households were exempted from silk and silver levies for Zhiyuan 12.

s0135.literal: On jimao day, because the Palace Guard had campaigned and garrisoned for many years, they were released home until the sixth month, then to rejoin their units.
s0135.idiomatic: On jimao day, because the Palace Guard had campaigned and garrisoned for years, they were sent home until the sixth month, when each was to rejoin his unit.

s0136.literal: On gengchen day the annual leather tribute from Udege allotted lands was hereafter to be delivered to Shangdu.
s0136.idiomatic: On gengchen day the annual leather tribute from Udege allotted lands was hereafter to be delivered to Shangdu.

s0137.literal: On renwu day Celestial Master Zhang Zongyan, heir to the Han line, was summoned to court.
s0137.idiomatic: On renwu day Celestial Master Zhang Zongyan, heir to the Han line, was summoned to court.

s0138.literal: On yiyou day Academician-Expositor of the Zhaowen Hall Yao Shu, Hanlin academician Wang Pan, and Hanlin expositor Tushan Gonglu were summoned to Shangdu.
s0138.idiomatic: On yiyou day Yao Shu, expositor of the Zhaowen Hall, Hanlin academician Wang Pan, and Hanlin expositor Tushan Gonglu were summoned to Shangdu.

s0139.literal: On gengyin day the imperial ancestral temple was repaired.
s0139.idiomatic: On gengyin day the imperial ancestral temple was repaired.

s0140.literal: Lian Xixian of the North Capital branch secretariat was made right vice chancellor and administered branch secretariat affairs at Jingnan Prefecture.
s0140.idiomatic: Lian Xixian of the North Capital branch secretariat was made right vice chancellor and put in charge of branch secretariat affairs at Jingnan Prefecture.

s0141.literal: In the fifth month, on the yiwei new moon, Bayan brought Zhao Shi to Shangdu; by decree Zhao Shi was made acting honorary grand master of the palace with protocol equal to the Three Excellencies and titular grand marshal, and enfeoffed as Duke of Ying.
s0141.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on the yiwei new moon, Bayan brought Zhao Shi to Shangdu; by decree Zhao Shi was made acting honorary grand master of the palace with protocol equal to the Three Excellencies and titular grand marshal, and enfeoffed as Duke of Ying.

s0142.literal: Because the Song had been pacified, officials were sent to announce Heaven and Earth and the imperial ancestors at the suburbs of Shangdu.
s0142.idiomatic: Because the Song had been pacified, officials were sent to announce the victory to Heaven and Earth and the imperial ancestors in the suburbs of Shangdu.

s0143.literal: Envoys were sent to sacrifice at the mountains and rivers in the sovereign's stead.
s0143.idiomatic: Envoys were sent to sacrifice at the mountains and rivers in the sovereign's stead.

s0144.literal: On jihai day Bayan asked to abolish the Two Zhes pacification commission and let Mangudai and Fan Wenhu continue administering the Two Zhes grand general's headquarters; this was approved.
s0144.idiomatic: On jihai day Bayan asked to abolish the Two Zhes pacification commission and let Mangudai and Fan Wenhu keep running the Two Zhes grand general's headquarters; the request was approved.

s0145.literal: On gengzi day weights and measures were fixed.
s0145.idiomatic: On gengzi day weights and measures were standardized.

s0146.literal: On renyin day forty-six Song academy students reached the capital.
s0146.idiomatic: On renyin day forty-six Song academy students reached the capital.

s0147.literal: On guimao day civilians conscripted as fort-garrison troops from the five prefectures Yi, Ju, Jiao, Mi, and Ninghai were restored to commoner status and exempted from rent and corvée for two years.
s0147.idiomatic: On guimao day civilians drafted as fort-garrison troops from Yi, Ju, Jiao, Mi, and Ninghai were restored to commoner status and exempted from rent and corvée for two years.

s0148.literal: On yisi day meritorious officers and soldiers of Bayan's command were granted twenty-four thousand six hundred taels of silver.
s0148.idiomatic: On yisi day meritorious officers and soldiers under Bayan were granted 24,600 taels of silver.

s0149.literal: Aju sent commander Chen Jie to storm Xincheng in Taizhou Prefecture and left wanhu Umar to hold it and press Taizhou.
s0149.idiomatic: Aju sent commander Chen Jie to storm Xincheng in Taizhou Prefecture and left wanhu Umar to hold it and press Taizhou.

s0150.literal: On dingwei day Song Yangzhou commander Jiang Cai attacked Wantou Fort; Alibe drove him off, killing four hundred infantry and cavalry; Right Guard qianhu Dong Shiyuan died in battle.
s0150.idiomatic: On dingwei day Song Yangzhou commander Jiang Cai attacked Wantou Fort; Alibe drove him off, killing 400 foot and horse soldiers; Right Guard qianhu Dong Shiyuan was killed in battle.

s0151.literal: On wushen day Song Commander Feng and others from Zhenzhou led two thousand troops and a hundred warships to raid Guazhou; Aju sent wanhu Shirhan, Atachih, and others into battle, routed them, pursued to Zhujinsha, took seventy-seven ships, and Feng and others drowned themselves.
s0151.idiomatic: On wushen day Song Commander Feng and others from Zhenzhou led 2,000 troops and 100 warships against Guazhou; Aju sent wanhu Shirhan, Atachih, and others into battle, routed them, pursued to Zhujinsha, took 77 ships, and Feng and his men drowned themselves.

s0152.literal: Bo Prefecture was redesignated Dongchang Route.
s0152.idiomatic: Bo Prefecture was redesignated Dongchang Route.

s0153.literal: On jiyou day hunter households and hawk-yard households were conscripted.
s0153.idiomatic: On jiyou day hunter households and hawk-yard households were drafted.

s0154.literal: On yimao day Jing Prefecture assistant prefect Zhang, Li Xin, and Li Fa burned their city and withdrew to defend Feishan New City; the branch secretariat sent troops to attack and kill them, and their followers and families were moved to Dadu.
s0154.idiomatic: On yimao day Jing Prefecture assistant prefect Zhang, Li Xin, and Li Fa burned their city and withdrew to Feishan New City; the branch secretariat sent troops to attack and kill them, and their followers and families were moved to Dadu.

s0155.literal: Song Jiangxi military commissioner Huang Wanshi came over with his army; an edict ordered him to audience.
s0155.idiomatic: Song Jiangxi military commissioner Huang Wanshi came over with his army; an edict ordered him to audience.

s0156.literal: On xinyou day the Anxi king's chief minister's office asked to issue an edict summoning Zhang Jue of He Prefecture; this was not approved.
s0156.idiomatic: On xinyou day the Anxi king's chief minister's office asked to issue an edict summoning Zhang Jue of He Prefecture; the request was denied.

s0157.literal: On guihai day the Bureau of Special Craft was promoted to a chief headquarters of third rank.
s0157.idiomatic: On guihai day the Bureau of Special Craft was promoted to a third-rank chief headquarters.

s0158.literal: In the sixth month, on the jiazi new moon, an edict released aged and weak soldiers of the three newly attached guards to their homes.
s0158.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on the jiazi new moon, an edict released aged and weak soldiers of the three newly attached guards to their homes.

s0159.literal: On jisi day Kong Zhi, fifty-third-generation descendant of Confucius and magistrate of Qufu County, was additionally placed in charge of sacrificial rites.
s0159.idiomatic: On jisi day Kong Zhi, fifty-third-generation descendant of Confucius and magistrate of Qufu, was additionally placed in charge of sacrificial rites.

s0160.literal: The eastern campaign marshal's headquarters was ordered to select five hundred Xiangyang veteran-coupon troops for the Palace Guard.
s0160.idiomatic: The eastern campaign marshal's headquarters was ordered to select 500 Xiangyang veteran-coupon troops for the Palace Guard.

s0161.literal: A mobile revenue department was established at Daming Prefecture to print paper currency and circulate Jiangnan trade.
s0161.idiomatic: A mobile revenue department was established at Daming Prefecture to print paper currency and circulate Jiangnan trade.

s0162.literal: On gengwu day an edict directed that Buddhist and Daoist clergy, Nestorian Christians, and Dasman with families pay taxes like common people.
s0162.idiomatic: On gengwu day an edict directed that Buddhist and Daoist clergy, Nestorian Christians, and Dasman with families pay taxes like common people.

s0163.literal: On xinwei day Ala Haiya was ordered to campaign in Guangxi; requesting reinforcements, thirty thousand troops were chosen for him to command.
s0163.idiomatic: On xinwei day Ala Haiya was ordered to campaign in Guangxi; he asked for reinforcements, and 30,000 troops were chosen for him to command.

s0164.literal: On renshen day the Two Zhes grand general's headquarters was abolished and mobile Ministries were established at E Prefecture and Lin'an.
s0164.idiomatic: On renshen day the Two Zhes grand general's headquarters was abolished and mobile ministries were established at E Prefecture and Lin'an.

s0165.literal: Pacification commissions were set up on all routes, headed by branch secretariat officials with concurrent chancellor ranks; where a branch secretariat existed, no pacification commission was established.
s0165.idiomatic: Pacification commissions were set up on all routes, headed by branch secretariat officials with concurrent chancellor ranks; where a branch secretariat existed, no pacification commission was established.

s0166.literal: On jiaxu day, because the Great Ming Calendar had drifted, crown prince tutor Wang Xun and Jiangnan calendar officers were ordered to establish an office to revise the calendar, with Vice Privy Councillor Zhang Yi supervising.
s0166.idiomatic: On jiaxu day, because the Great Ming Calendar had drifted, crown prince tutor Wang Xun and Jiangnan calendar officers were ordered to set up an office to revise the calendar, with Vice Privy Councillor Zhang Yi supervising.

s0167.literal: Zhang Yi and Wang Xun memorialized: "Today's calendrical specialists know techniques but rarely understand principles; a senior scholar such as Xu Heng should be consulted.
s0167.idiomatic: Zhang Yi and Wang Xun memorialized, "Today's calendar specialists know technique but rarely understand principle; a senior scholar such as Xu Heng should be consulted.

s0168.literal: " An edict summoned Xu Heng to the capital.
s0168.idiomatic: An edict summoned Xu Heng to the capital.

s0169.literal: Song Yangzhou commander Jiang Cai led several thousand foot and horse by night toward Dingcun Fort; garrison commanders Shi Bi and Tanchie gave battle, beheading more than a hundred and taking forty horses.
s0169.idiomatic: Song Yangzhou commander Jiang Cai led several thousand foot and horse by night toward Dingcun Fort; garrison commanders Shi Bi and Tanchie gave battle, beheading more than a hundred and taking 40 horses.

s0170.literal: At dawn Ari and superintendent Chen Yan intercepted from behind with Wantou Fort troops; Bayan Qorqiji arrived in pursuit leading Aju's troops; Jiang Cai's army fled at the sight of their banners and was routed, with more than five thousand shi of grain captured.
s0170.idiomatic: At dawn Ari and superintendent Chen Yan cut them off from behind with Wantou Fort troops; Bayan Qorqiji arrived in pursuit with Aju's men; Jiang Cai's army fled at the sight of their banners and was routed, and more than 5,000 shi of grain were taken.

s0171.literal: Aju also reasoned that with Gaoyou's water route closed the Song must supply grain overland; qianhu Yesunqu led a thousand horse to intercept; after several days the grain convoy came as expected; thousands of bearers were killed and three thousand shi of grain taken.
s0171.idiomatic: Aju also judged that with Gaoyou's water route cut the Song must supply grain overland; qianhu Yesunqu led 1,000 horse to intercept; after several days the grain convoy came as expected; thousands of bearers were killed and 3,000 shi of grain were taken.

s0172.literal: On wuyin day an edict ordered compilation of Records of the Pacification of Jin and Pacification of Song, and biographies of submitting states, with councilor of state affairs Yelü Zhu supervising revision of the national history.
s0172.idiomatic: On wuyin day an edict ordered compilation of Records of the Pacification of Jin and Pacification of Song and biographies of submitting states, with councilor of state affairs Yelü Zhu supervising revision of the national history.

s0173.literal: On wuzi day the Privy Council reported: "Chen Yizhong and Zhang Shijie are massing troops in Fujian to attack our forces; Jiangxi commander Song Dudu requests aid.
s0173.idiomatic: On wuzi day the Privy Council reported that Chen Yizhong and Zhang Shijie were massing troops in Fujian to attack our forces and that Jiangxi commander Song Dudu was asking for aid.

s0174.literal: " Troops garrisoned at Anqing, Qi, Huang, and other prefectures were ordered to Song Dudu.
s0174.idiomatic: Troops garrisoned at Anqing, Qi, Huang, and other prefectures were placed under Song Dudu.

s0175.literal: On jichou day Song Dudu reported that Wei Tianyou and You Yirong of Fujian abandoned their families to submit; Tianyou was made garrison commander and acting prefect of Shaowu Army, Yirong was remotely appointed associate prefect of Jianning Route and made garrison qianhu.
s0175.idiomatic: On jichou day Song Dudu reported that Wei Tianyou and You Yirong of Fujian had abandoned their families to submit; Tianyou was made garrison commander and acting prefect of Shaowu Army, and Yirong was remotely appointed associate prefect of Jianning Route and made garrison qianhu.

s0176.literal: On renchen day an edict summoned Song Huai-dong commissioner Li Tingzhi and subordinate officers, and officials great and small of Tong, Tai, Zhen, Chu, and Gaoyou.
s0176.idiomatic: On renchen day an edict summoned Song Huai-dong commissioner Li Tingzhi and his subordinate officers, and officials great and small of Tong, Tai, Zhen, Chu, and Gaoyou.

s0177.literal: Another edict urged Chen Yizhong, Zhang Shijie, Su Liuyi, Liu Shiyong, and others to surrender.
s0177.idiomatic: Another edict urged Chen Yizhong, Zhang Shijie, Su Liuyi, Liu Shiyong, and others to surrender.

s0178.literal: Li Tingzhi left Zhu Huan to hold Yangzhou and fled east with Jiang Cai and five thousand troops; Aju personally galloped off with over a hundred horse, directing right vice chancellor Ari and wanhu Liu Guojie on separate tracks to catch them west of Taizhou, killing a thousand foot soldiers; Li Tingzhi and others barely entered the city, then built long trenches and maintained siege; Aju alone held the southeast and cut off escape.
s0178.idiomatic: Li Tingzhi left Zhu Huan to hold Yangzhou and fled east with Jiang Cai and 5,000 troops; Aju personally galloped off with more than 100 horse, directing right vice chancellor Ari and wanhu Liu Guojie on separate tracks to catch them west of Taizhou and kill 1,000 foot soldiers; Li Tingzhi and his party barely got into the city, then dug long trenches and held siege lines; Aju alone blocked the southeast and cut off escape.

s0179.literal: Minister of Revenue Zhang Shu was made vice grand councillor, administering branch secretariat affairs at the North Capital.
s0179.idiomatic: Minister of Revenue Zhang Shu was made vice grand councillor and put in charge of branch secretariat affairs at the North Capital.

s0180.literal: In autumn, seventh month, on yiwei day branch secretariat langzhong Meng Qi presented Song jade, gold, treasures, tally-plaques, and seals; the Imperial Treasury was ordered to receive them.
s0180.idiomatic: In autumn, seventh month, on yiwei day branch secretariat langzhong Meng Qi presented Song jade, gold, treasures, tally-plaques, and seals, and the imperial treasury was ordered to receive them.

s0181.literal: On bingshen day more than ten thousand displaced persons from Huai'an and Baoying in Pi Prefecture were permitted to return home.
s0181.idiomatic: On bingshen day more than 10,000 displaced persons from Huai'an and Baoying in Pi Prefecture were permitted to return home.

s0182.literal: On dingyou day Song Fu Prefecture inspector Yang Li's son Sizong asked for an edict summoning his father; this was approved.
s0182.idiomatic: On dingyou day Song Fu Prefecture inspector Yang Li's son Sizong asked for an edict summoning his father; the request was approved.

s0183.literal: On wuxu day Lang Prefecture was promoted to Baoning Prefecture.
s0183.idiomatic: On wuxu day Lang Prefecture was promoted to Baoning Prefecture.

s0184.literal: An edict made Shandan Fort directly subordinate to the ministries, the traveling darughachi continuing to administer it.
s0184.idiomatic: An edict made Shandan Fort directly subordinate to the ministries, with the traveling darughachi continuing to administer it.

s0185.literal: On renyin day, because Li Ting had gone on campaign, his subordinates Li Chengqing and others were rewarded with paper currency, horses, clothing, and armor in graded amounts.
s0185.idiomatic: On renyin day, because Li Ting had gone on campaign, his subordinates Li Chengqing and others were rewarded with paper currency, horses, clothing, and armor in graded amounts.

s0186.literal: On yisi day Zhu Huan surrendered Yangzhou.
s0186.idiomatic: On yisi day Zhu Huan surrendered Yangzhou.

s0187.literal: On dingwei day an edict instructed officials of Jingjiang Prefecture and other Guangxi prefectures and cities to surrender.
s0187.idiomatic: On dingwei day an edict instructed officials of Jingjiang Prefecture and other Guangxi prefectures and cities to surrender.

s0188.literal: On jiayin day Prince Boluo was granted a seal.
s0188.idiomatic: On jiayin day Prince Boluo was granted a seal.

s0189.literal: Because the canal from Yangcun to Fuijibo circuit was too long, it was rerouted through Sunjiawu.
s0189.idiomatic: Because the canal from Yangcun to Fuijibo was too circuitous, it was rerouted through Sunjiawu.

s0190.literal: On yimao day Song Taizhou defender Sun Liangchen and Li Tingzhi's soldiers Liu Fa and Zheng Jun opened the north gate to surrender, seized Li Tingzhi and Jiang Cai, and imprisoned them at Yangzhou.
s0190.idiomatic: On yimao day Song Taizhou defender Sun Liangchen and Li Tingzhi's soldiers Liu Fa and Zheng Jun opened the north gate to surrender, seized Li Tingzhi and Jiang Cai, and imprisoned them at Yangzhou.

s0191.literal: On bingchen day Aju left commander Umar and others to hold Taizhou; Tong, Chu, Gaoyou, and other places submitted in succession.
s0191.idiomatic: On bingchen day Aju left commander Umar and others to hold Taizhou; Tong, Chu, Gaoyou, and other places submitted in succession.

s0192.literal: Huai-dong Route gained sixteen prefectures, thirty-three counties, five hundred forty-two thousand six hundred twenty-four households, and one million eighty-three thousand two hundred seventeen persons.
s0192.idiomatic: Huai-dong Route gained 16 prefectures, 33 counties, 542,624 households, and 1,083,217 persons.

s0193.literal: Envoys were sent with incense and silks to sacrifice at the mountains, rivers, and earth-altar.
s0193.idiomatic: Envoys were sent with incense and silks to sacrifice at the mountains, rivers, and earth-altar.

s0194.literal: Right vice chancellor Ala Haiya was made councilor of state; signatory of the privy council and Huai-dong mobile privy council officer Begirmish was made right vice chancellor; vice grand councillor Dong Wenbing was made left vice chancellor; Huai-dong left deputy commander Tacu, Two Zhes grand commander Fan Wenhu, Jiang-dong/Jiang-xi grand commander and Jiang Prefecture prefect Lü Shi'ao, and Huai-dong/Huai-xi left deputy commander Chen Yan were all made vice grand councillors.
s0194.idiomatic: Right vice chancellor Ala Haiya was made councilor of state; privy council signatory and Huai-dong mobile privy council officer Begirmish was made right vice chancellor; vice grand councillor Dong Wenbing was made left vice chancellor; and Huai-dong left deputy commander Tacu, Two Zhes grand commander Fan Wenhu, Jiang-dong/Jiang-xi grand commander and Jiang Prefecture prefect Lü Shi'ao, and Huai-dong/Huai-xi left deputy commander Chen Yan were all made vice grand councillors.

s0195.literal: In the eighth month, on jisi day, the canal at Mengcun in Wuqing was excavated.
s0195.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on jisi day, the canal at Mengcun in Wuqing was excavated.

s0196.literal: An edict directed Han army commander-in-chief Kuokuo Dai and Li Ting to lead two thousand Palace Guard troops west on campaign.
s0196.idiomatic: An edict directed Han army commander-in-chief Kuokuo Dai and Li Ting to lead 2,000 Palace Guard troops west on campaign.

s0197.literal: Huoyin County was promoted to Huo Prefecture.
